title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
content_md: One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Both flaws let anyone execute code on the web server without authentication. The disclosure itself went a little wrong.

CVE-2026-109618.evidence: Palo Alto Networks confirmed attackers exploiting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 against internet-exposed PAN-OS management interfaces on October 28.
